fn primeLog(int n ? n >= 2) = 1
    *= prod k from 2 to n (
        define divisors sum d from 2 to k-1 (
            = 0
            += 1 ? (k % d == 0)
        )
        = k
        ^= 1 ? (divisors == 0) else 0
    )
    >> ln
end
